info.name: EVE Swagger Interface Alliance Industry API
EVE Online List Character Industry Jobs

params.name: character_id
params.description: An EVE character ID

params.name: datasource
params.description: The server name you would like data from

params.name: include_completed
params.description: Whether to retrieve completed character industry jobs. Only includes jobs from the past 90 days

params.name: token
params.description: Access token to use if unable to set a header

items.docs:
List industry jobs placed by a character

Alternate route: `/legacy/characters/{character_id}/industry/jobs/`

Alternate route: `/v1/characters/{character_id}/industry/jobs/`

This route is cached for up to 300 seconds
